    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsNumShared
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsShared
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsNumerator
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # denominator
    hints_bit_data += b'\x80'                    # nObjects[0] bit
    hints_bit_data += b'\x80'                    # pageLength[0] bit
    hints_bit_data += b'\x00'                    # numSharedObject[0] bit

    # Build the hints object
    hints_obj_content = (
        b'5 0 obj\n'
        b'<< /S 0 /Length ' + str(len(hints_bit_data)).encode() + b' >>\n'
        b'stream\n'
        + hints_bit_data +
        b'\nendstream\nendobj\n'
    )

    # Build all objects first to calculate sizes
    obj1 = (
        b'1 0 obj\n'
        b'<< /Linearized 1 /L 999999 /O 2 /E 100 /N 1 /T 999999'
        b' /H [ 999999 999999 ] /P 0 >>\n'
        b'endobj\n'
    )
    obj2 = b'2 0 obj\n<< /Type /Page /Parent 3 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] >>\nendobj\n'
    obj3 = b'3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [2 0 R] /Count 1 >>\nendobj\n'
    obj4 = b'4 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 3 0 R >>\nendobj\n'

    # Calculate offsets
    header = b'%PDF-1.4\n%\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF\n'
    
    offsets = {}
    pdf = bytearray()
    pdf.extend(header)
    offsets['obj1'] = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(obj1)
    offsets['obj2'] = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(obj2)
    offsets['obj3'] = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(obj3)
    offsets['obj4'] = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(obj4)
    offsets['hints'] = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(hints_obj_content)
    offsets['xref'] = len(pdf)
    
    # XRef
    num_objects = 6
    xref = f'xref\n0 {num_objects}\n0000000000 65535 f \n'
    xref += f'{offsets["obj1"]:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{offsets["obj2"]:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{offsets["obj3"]:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{offsets["obj4"]:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{offsets["hints"]:010d} 00000 n \n'
    pdf.extend(xref.encode())
    
    # Trailer
    trailer = f'trailer\n<< /Size {num_objects} /Root 4 0 R >>\n'
    pdf.extend(trailer.encode())
    pdf.extend(b'startxref\n')
    pdf.extend(f'{offsets["xref"]}\n'.encode())
    pdf.extend(b'%%EOF\n')
    
    file_len = len(pdf)
    
    # Fix obj1
    obj1_fixed = (
        f'1 0 obj\n'
        f'<< /Linearized 1 /L {file_len} /O 2 /E 100 /N 1 /T {offsets["xref"]}'
        f' /H [ {offsets["hints"]} {len(hints_obj_content)} ] /P 0 >>\n'
        f'endobj\n'
    ).encode()
    
    # Replace obj1
    pdf[offsets['obj1']:offsets['obj1']+len(obj1)] = obj1_fixed
    
    return bytes(pdf)
